**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `c552b832193998b386f4c2cea433e71eb08b6729`.

Full verdict carries forward the completed, unpublished `d6e42aa` cost review and earlier [eb37f6a verdict](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/157#issuecomment-6710198523). The main merge resolves the previous conflict. The PR-owned file set is unchanged; freeze implementation/tests are identical. The shared difficulties merge retains D-219-1 and D-220-1.

**Manual tool only:** no added timer, polling/retry loop or per-seat/per-tick work. Latest check ordering parses job IDs from already-fetched URLs. Exact SUCCESS in the no-parser Delivers fallback and explicit `isDraft === false` use the existing response/map, with no new gh call. The newest conclusion is retained in memory. The tri-state entry/guard uses the same two realpath resolutions on a healthy invocation; a lookup failure reports and exits 2 instead of silently skipping.

**Per ordinary complete invocation:** baseline **8 git + one gh + optional already-built parser**, plus S `status --porcelain` probes of matching-name, detached, exact-head worktree candidates, stopping at the first usable one. Thus **8+S git calls**, not a universal fixed maximum. With one clean candidate: nine git calls ordinarily, eleven for `--worktree` reuse. Fresh creation with no candidate: ten git calls. Worktree mode repeats listing/inspection before reuse, refusal or creation. Multiple unusable candidates make the status count input-dependent.

The recipe uses local tsx; it does not install dependencies or implicitly compile the parser. These are direct Runner-call counts, not a bound on Node/tsx, git or gh descendants, transferred bytes, filesystem work or wall time. Synchronous commands have no explicit deadline; status can scan tracked/untracked worktree content. Captured output's 64 MiB per-stream limit is not a total parsed-memory cap.

**P157-N001 remains:** grouping same-name runs spreads/copies earlier entries on each insertion, O(sum(runs-per-name squared)) shallow copying before linear selection. This is minor at normal rollup sizes and command-local; growing superseded history can increase it. Nothing in the merge or final guard repairs worsens this cost model.

**CI:** merged-head [42398158810](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42398158810) succeeds at the exact SHA. Node 22 executes **24 freeze tests**, including job-ID ordering, superseded/unfinished checks, strict SUCCESS fallback with SKIPPED/NEUTRAL negatives and positive control, absent-draft negative, injected realpath error, run/import controls, exact/clean/detached worktrees, and actual symlinked CLI usage. Vitest **2,228 passed / six skipped**; Node 24 and Rust checks also pass. Latest Delivers **42398158925** succeeds at this SHA.

Most command paths use fake gh/git/parser results; this is not a live latency, transfer or large-worktree benchmark. No local build, test, mutation, freeze invocation, runtime probe or worktree edit. Reviewer/security own full FINAL and argument-safety correctness. No migration or daemon after-deploy obligation is introduced by this manual tool.
